Name: Move Between Buildings
Author: vilaboa0008
Description:
[u][size=4]Features
[/size][/u]
Use path tiles next to buildings to establish connections. The direction of the tile indicates the building you'll move to: left for left, right for right, etc.

For example as shown in the [b]image[/b] below, if you are in a barn and you want to move to a coop to your right, place the path tile to the right of the barn and to the left of the coop.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/17391/17391-1689325083-887378344.png[/img]

Compatibility-wise, this mod works with all buildings that can be built by Robin: barn, coop, shed, slime hutch, and cabin (with the cabins you will be teleported to the entrance). Please note that as of the current version, this mod does not support the main farmhouse and the greenhouse.
﻿
"Note: When there are multiple path tiles, your destination is determined by the first tile placed. However, you can teleport from any path tile. If you want to change the destination, it is recommended to break the existing path tiles and place your desired destination path tile first.

[size=4][u]Installation Instructions

[/u][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4][u]Notes
[/u][/size]
This is my first mod, so your feedback is crucial. If you encounter any bugs or have any suggestions for improvements, please don't hesitate to share them. Your input will help me shape future updates. Thank you!
